text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having concluded her challenge for the Triple Tiara,
Air Groove earned acclaim as the "Empress,"
basking in the spotlight of the public eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, however...
The exploits of a certain Umamusume were also beginning to generate buzz—

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Silence Suzuka in the lead!
Silence Suzuka in the lead!"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In the lead is Silence Suzuka!
She went wire-to-wire after all! Strong, she's just too strong!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume hailed as the "Out of this World Escape Artist"—
Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When considering Air Groove's future challenges, Silence Suzuka is an opponent that can never be overlooked...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Senior Class is just around the corner. I'll need to talk with Air Groove about our future plans again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, a large-scale joint mock race meet hosted by the Student Council is being held to improve everyone's skills.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove was involved as part of the event staff.
While I was lending a hand to help out—

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, isn't that...
Silence Suzuka-san?

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh—
It's true! You're entering a practice race!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
A chance to run seriously against Silence Suzuka...
An opportunity like this is rare...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...With the entrance of the much-talked-about Silence Suzuka, a sudden murmur rippled through both the onlookers and participants.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that... Suzuka...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove, who was standing nearby, stared
at Silence Suzuka with eyes full of astonishment...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You may not recall, but Suzuka and I go back quite a ways.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've run side-by-side with her many times.
I thought I understood her potential.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What on earth happened to Suzuka...?
She's like—a completely different person.
choice_data_list: What on earth does that mean...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply—
Suzuka's aura is completely different from before.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Lately, both of us had been devoting ourselves to the Twinkle Series.
Though we might pass each other on campus...
we hadn't faced each other on the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'd watched her races on screen before, but...
I never imagined she could go that far—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is there something only exceptional Umamusume
can intuitively sense in each other?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove stared intently at Silence Suzuka,
and eventually—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I have to find out for myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove suddenly walked away,
so I hurriedly chased after her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Everything has gone without a hitch so far.
The next group is—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —President!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove?
Did something happen over in the stands?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, there are no operational issues whatsoever.
I have come to make a personal request.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...A personal favor?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I apologize for the sudden and insolent request, but—
would you allow me to run with Suzuka?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...It is rare for you to plead like this.
I wouldn't be reluctant to hear you out, however,
Silence Suzuka's group assignment has already—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Please, from me as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You're saying... I may run with Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. I also wanted to run a bit with the current Air Groove, so...

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-senpai is running against
Silence Suzuka-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it's for real?!
I can't miss out on this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The surrounding Umamusume grew stirred up by the impending clash between the two, the excitement quickly spreading like wildfire.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. If that's the case, so be it.
I grant permission for your participation in the mock race.
I'll arrange the lineup on my end.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —I truly appreciate your generous consideration.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, on short notice, a mock race between Air Groove and Silence Suzuka was arranged—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah--!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka dashes ahead, with Air Groove in pursuit.
The race unfolds on the track exactly as everyone had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(—Guh, what incredible speed!
This front-running is on a whole different level from before...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Still, she's within striking distance—
I know she'll pull off the late charge...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Approaching the final corner,
Air Groove makes her move. But—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hup——

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (What?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka accelerates.
Far from closing the gap, Air Groove
is left even further behind.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (I-Impossible—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...In that race, Air Groove couldn't even catch a glimpse of Silence Suzuka's shadow before it was over.

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
T-There it is! Leading the whole way
and accelerating at the end! Seeing it in person is insane!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Managing to outrun even Air Groove-senpai...
Isn't that amazing...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Good work, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah... Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...That was magnificent, Suzuka.
I'm truly glad we were able to run together today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, me too.
I'd love to run together in the real race next time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, indeed.
I'm looking forward to it."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, as I sat in the trainer's office
reflecting on today's race between Air Groove and
Silence Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...So this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There's something I need to talk to you about. Well, more like... a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Please enter me in whichever race
Suzuka is most likely to run.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just as you witnessed...
Today, I suffered a complete defeat at the hands of Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In my battles going forward,
I cannot avoid Suzuka. If so—
choice_data_list: First, let's make the Osaka Hai our goal.
First, let's aim for the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided that this race gave the highest likelihood of Silence Suzuka entering.
It was the most suitable choice to set as an immediate goal.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me. And thank you.
I will definitely win next time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the goal to "defeat Silence Suzuka"was agreed upon between Air Groove and myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"My target is the Osaka Hai!
I can't just leave things as a loss!"
